name: ad-corporate-income-tax
description: "Andorra corporate income tax for resident companies and other entities in tax year 2026. Covers accounting-profit reconciliation, depreciation, impairments, provisions, financing limits, ordinary participation and foreign permanent-establishment exemptions, authorised holding and intellectual-property relief, loss carryforwards, the combined minimum settlement, foreign and domestic credits, advances, property transfers and filing. Includes corporate residence, migration valuation and the 2026 tax-administration ruling on departure gains, plus penalties and source-linked working papers. Use for Andorra IS, company tax, holding-company exemption, loss relief, September instalments, July returns and corporate exit-tax questions. Source-cited draft requiring professional review of the actual facts, records, authorisations and operative treaties."

name: ad-income-tax
description: "Compute Andorra resident personal income tax for calendar 2026, including employment, pensions, direct or objective sole-trader income, rental income, investments and capital gains. Use for fiscal residence, IRPF allowances and proportional bonus, family and housing reductions, loss pools, property sale and reinvestment, foreign-tax credits, advances and annual return reconciliation. This Guide distinguishes employment expense relief from business deductions, general income from savings and resident property taxation from IRNR. Read the payroll and social Guide for the actual 2026 CASS category and wage period, the IGI Guide for indirect tax, and the corporate and cross-border Guides for their separate computations. Figures require the cited facts and documents. Source-cited draft, without accountant attestation."

name: ad-non-resident-income-tax
description: "Andorra non-resident income tax and cross-border working papers for individuals, companies and permanent establishments in tax year 2026. Covers residence and source tests, services, royalties, employment, rental and capital income, domestic exemptions, gross withholding, property gains and buyer retention. Includes ordinary PE accounting adjustments, restricted head-office charges, losses and credits, advances, final cessation valuation, company migration and individual pending-income attribution. Explains filing, representatives, evidence, refunds, current penalties and interest. Provides selected Spain and France treaty methods using authority texts incorporating the MLI, plus resident foreign-tax credit rules. Use for Andorra IRNR, overseas supplier payments, non-resident landlords, branches, departure and treaty-relief questions. Source-cited draft requiring professional review."

name: ad-payroll-social
description: "Andorra payroll and CASS social security for tax year 2026. Covers resident employee IRPF withholding, non-resident employment and the elected frontier or seasonal method, ordinary employee and employer contributions, working pension recipients, self-employed income and turnover tiers, director classification, startup reductions, the separate young-worker regime and health complements. Distinguishes the January and July minimum wages and the 2026 average-salary reference. Includes gross-to-net reconciliation, benefits and reimbursements, employer and worker registrations, monthly combined CASS and tax declarations, non-CASS filing, rate notices, regularisation and penalties. Use for Andorra payroll, employee net salary, employer cost, retencions, CASS0031, compte propi and contribution-base questions. Source-cited draft requiring professional review."

description: "Andorra transfer pricing for resident companies, related individuals, group entities and permanent establishments in tax year 2026. description: "Use this skill whenever asked about UAE Corporate Tax for freelancers, sole establishments, or small businesses. Trigger on phrases like \"how much tax do I pay in UAE\", \"corporate tax UAE\", \"CT return\", \"FTA\", \"small business relief\", \"free zone tax\", \"qualifying free zone person\", \"AED 375,000\", \"9% tax\", \"taxable income UAE\", \"corporate tax registration\", \"UAE tax return\", \"self-employed tax UAE\", \"freelancer tax Dubai\", \"EmaraTax\", or any question about computing or filing UAE corporate tax. name: bulgaria-payroll
description: "Bulgarian payroll for employees for tax year 2026, in euro. Covers the monthly gross-to-net: employee and employer social contributions on the insurable income (floor and ceiling), health insurance, the 10% wage tax withheld on gross pay less the employee's own contributions, the annual recalculation by 31 January, and filing of Declarations 1 and 6 and payment by the 25th of the next month. Uses the 2026 minimum wage (EUR 620.20) and the two ceilings for 2026 (EUR 2,111.64 to 31 July, EUR 2,300 from 1 August). Lev amounts are shown in euro at BGN 1.95583. Trigger phrases: Bulgaria payroll, gross to net Bulgaria, заплата, данък по чл. 42 ЗДДФЛ, Декларация образец 1, Декларация образец 6, осигуровки работодател. Out of scope: self-employed contributions and fund-by-fund detail (bulgaria-social-contributions), the annual income tax return (bulgaria-income-tax), posted workers and treaties (bg-cross-border)."

description: "Bulgarian social and health insurance contributions for tax year 2026, in euro. name: ch-ahv-iv
description: "Swiss AHV/IV/EO social contributions of the self-employed and of non-employed persons for 2026. Covers who counts as self-employed, the full rate of 10.0% (AHV 8.1%, IV 1.4%, EO 0.5%) from CHF 60,500, the full sliding scale from CHF 10,100 (5.371%) and the minimum contribution of CHF 530, how the contribution income is found (tax assessment, add-back of own contributions, interest on own capital, rounding), provisional (Akonto) and final contributions, the allowance past reference age, 5% late interest, non-employed contributions by wealth (CHF 530 to 26,500), voluntary BVG and the pillar 3a limits for 2026 (CHF 7,258 / 20% up to CHF 36,288). Trigger on: AHV Selbständige, AHV/IV/EO self-employed, sinkende Beitragsskala, Akontobeiträge, Beitragsverfügung, Nichterwerbstätige AHV, Säule 3a Selbständige. Out of scope: ch-payroll (employees), ch-federal-income-tax and ch-cantonal-tax (the tax return), ch-cross-border (which country insures)."

name: ch-cantonal-tax
description: "Swiss cantonal and communal income and wealth tax on individuals for tax year 2026, from the StHG, the ESTV tables and cantonal sources. Covers how the tax is built (simple tax from the cantonal tariff, times the cantonal, communal and church multipliers), the 2026 multipliers in all 26 cantonal capitals, the Zurich and Zug 2026 tariffs, wealth tax thresholds, deductions that differ by canton (commuting caps, childcare), filing deadlines for Zurich, Zug, Bern, Basel-Stadt, Geneva and Vaud, the 31 December rule when moving between cantons, interest and penalties. Two worked examples: CHF 100,000 taxable income in Zurich city and in Zug city. Trigger on: Kantonssteuer, Gemeindesteuer, Steuerfuss, einfache Steuer, Kirchensteuer, impôt cantonal et communal, centimes additionnels, Vermögenssteuer, moving canton, Swiss income tax by canton. Out of scope: ch-federal-income-tax, ch-payroll (tax at source), ch-cross-border, ch-lump-sum, ch-corporate-income-tax."

description: "Swiss profit tax on companies for tax year 2026, from the law and ESTV publications. name: ch-cross-border
description: "Switzerland cross-border tax hub for 2026: when a person or company becomes or stops being taxable in Switzerland. Covers the residence tests for individuals (DBG art. 3: domicile, or a stay of 30 days with work or 90 days without) and companies (seat or effective management), arriving (lump-sum taxation under DBG art. 14, tax at source for foreign employees and the subsequent ordinary assessment from 2021), leaving (no exit tax for individuals; hidden reserves and 35% withholding tax when a company moves abroad), non-residents with Swiss income (employment, board fees, mortgage interest, pensions), the 35% Verrechnungssteuer and treaty refunds, and EU social security coordination. Calendar tax year. Trigger on: moving to Switzerland, leaving Switzerland, non-resident, expat, Quellensteuer, NOV, Pauschalbesteuerung, exit tax, Verrechnungssteuer refund, Grenzgänger. name: ch-transfer-pricing
description: "Swiss transfer pricing for 2026. Switzerland has no transfer pricing statute: the arm's length principle works through profit tax (DBG art. 58 para. 1 let. b and c, StHG art. 24) and the 35% withholding tax on hidden profit distributions (geldwerte Leistungen, VStG art. 4 para. 1 let. b). Covers related parties, hidden profit distributions and hidden capital contributions, the ESTV safe-harbour interest rates for 2026 (CHF and foreign currency), service companies (Kreisschreiben 4), the burden of proof, rulings, APAs, MAP (StADG), country-by-country reporting (CHF 900 million), penalties, and the 35% withholding with the gross-up when it is not passed on. Trigger on: transfer pricing Switzerland, Verrechnungspreise, geldwerte Leistung, verdeckte Gewinnausschüttung, safe harbour Zinssätze, shareholder loan interest, CbCR Schweiz. Out of scope: ch-corporate-income-tax (rates, base), ch-cross-border (treaty refunds, migration), ch-cantonal-tax."

name: cn-withholding
description: "当用户咨询、计算、审核或申报中国预提所得税（源泉扣缴）相关事项时，必须始终先阅读本技能文档。触发关键词包括：\"中国预提所得税\"、\"非居民企业税收\"、\"10% 股息预提税\"、\"特许权使用费预提税\"、\"代扣代缴\"、\"源泉扣缴\"、\"中国DTA税收协定\"、\"非居民企业所得税\"、\"间接转让\"、\"698号文\"、\"7号公告\"、\"受益所有人\"、\"协定优惠\"、\"China WHT\"、\"China withholding tax\"、\"non-resident enterprise tax\"、\"China dividend WHT 10%\"、\"China DTA tax treaty\"、\"PRC withholding tax\"、\"China royalty withholding\"、\"China interest withholding\"、\"China indirect transfer\"、\"SAT Bulletin 9\"、\"SAT Bulletin 35\"。本技能涵盖《中华人民共和国企业所得税法》第三章及第五章项下非居民企业（无机构场所）取得的中国境内来源所得的源泉扣缴（股息 10%、利息 10%、特许权使用费 10%、财产转让 10%、租金 10%），并涵盖《中华人民共和国个人所得税法》第九条项下扣缴义务人对工资薪金、劳务报酬、稿酬、特许权使用费、利息股息红利的代扣代缴义务，以及境外服务进口情形下境内购买方作为增值税扣缴义务人的代扣代缴义务（财税〔2016〕36号文附件1第六条）。同时涵盖税收协定（DTA）适用、受益所有人判定（《国家税务总局公告2018年第9号》）、协定优惠\"自行判定、事后管理\"程序（《国家税务总局公告2019年第35号》），以及非居民企业间接转让中国境内财产的征税规则（《国家税务总局公告2015年第7号》及国税函〔2009〕698号文）。不适用于：居民企业之间股息免税、合伙企业税收处理、特别纳税调整（转让定价）、CRS信息交换、外汇管制实务（SAFE）。**任何中国预提所得税相关工作动手之前，必须始终阅读本技能。**"

name: cross-border-tax-router
description: "Entry point for the OpenAccountants cross-border / international personal-tax skill library. ALWAYS load this skill first when a person's facts touch more than one country — e.g. a US citizen living abroad, a dual resident, someone moving countries, a non-dom, an expatriating citizen, a foreign trust or foreign company owner, or \"how is this taxed in country A and country B\". The router computes nothing. It (1) builds the person's residency / citizenship / domicile map, (2) identifies which country skills and which international topic skills the facts engage, (3) gates out corridors the library does not yet cover, (4) SEQUENCES the steps — in cross-border, the order of events changes the tax (sever residency before vs. after a sale), and (5) hands off to cross-border-tax-workflow-base plus the topic skills. Every international topic skill (FEIE/FTC, FBAR/FATCA, CFC/GILTI, foreign trusts, exit tax) assumes this routing step has happened first."

name: de-franchise-tax-and-llc
description: "Delaware LLCs, LPs, and GPs owe a flat $300 annual tax due June 1, regardless of income or activity. Delaware corporations owe annual franchise tax due March 1 computed under two methods — the Authorized Shares Method (flat tiers from $175 up to a $200,000 cap) and the Assumed Par Value Capital Method ($400 floor to the same $200,000 cap, $250,000 for Large Corporate Filers). Taxpayers pay the lower of the two. Corporations also file an annual report with officer/director and gross asset information. No Delaware corporate income tax applies unless the entity has Delaware-source income. Tax year 2025."

name: ee-corporate-income-tax
description: "Estonian corporate income tax for tax year 2026 under the Income Tax Act (tulumaksuseadus) consolidated text in force from 1 October 2026. Estonia taxes a company only when it distributes profit: 22% of the gross amount, charged as 22/78 of the net payment. name: leaving-south-africa-tax-emigration
description: "South Africa replaced 'financial emigration' with a purely tax-driven exit in 2021, and most leavers still run the old playbook. This Guide sequences the modern exit."

description: "Use this skill whenever asked to prepare, review, or classify transactions for a Liechtenstein VAT (MWST) return for any client. description: "Cross-border skill for individuals moving to Malta, tax year 2026. Also lists what Malta does tax: Malta work, rent, property transfers, duty. Trigger on: move to Malta, Malta non-dom, Malta GRP, Malta nomad tax, Malta HQP."

name: nd-corporate-tax
description: "Use when asked about ND Corporate Tax. North Dakota imposes a graduated corporate income tax under N.D.C.C. Chapter 57-38 (the Income Tax Act of 1981) at three statutory brackets: 1.41% on the first $25,000, 3.55% on the next $25,000 (to $50,000), and 4.31% on income above $50,000 [VERIFY: NDCC § 57-38-30 for TY 2025 thresholds]. ND does not impose a separate corporate franchise tax (contrast NC, TX, DE) and does not currently offer a pass-through entity tax (PTET) election — leaving ND S-corp and partnership owners without a federal SALT-cap workaround. The corporation return is Form 40, due the 15th day of the 4th month after year-end. ND apportions corporate income using a three-factor formula (property, payroll, sales) with the sales factor double-weighted by default and an optional single-sales-factor election for qualifying taxpayers [VERIFY: NDCC § 57-38.1-09 / Form 40 instructions]. name: norway-to-switzerland-wealth-tax-exit
description: "Norway's wealth tax plus dividend tax created Europe's most visible wealth exodus, and the rules were rewritten mid-flight: the old wait-out-five-years exit tax is gone, replaced by a pay-within-12-years regime, while tax residency itself takes three full years to shed. This Guide sequences the Norwegian exit — the 3-year tail, the exit tax architecture, what stays Norwegian — and the Swiss landing, including the modified-forfait requirement Norway's treaty imposes on lump-sum residents."

name: ny-mctmt
description: "The NY Metropolitan Commuter Transportation Mobility Tax (MCTMT, Tax Law Article 23) is a payroll-and-self-employment tax on employers and self-employed individuals doing business in the Metropolitan Commuter Transportation District (MCTD): the five NYC boroughs (Zone 1) and the suburban counties of Dutchess, Nassau, Orange, Putnam, Rockland, Suffolk, and Westchester (Zone 2). Quarterly payroll brackets run from 0.11% up to 0.60% in Zone 1 and 0.34% in Zone 2. Self-employed individuals owe MCTMT only when MCTD-allocated net earnings exceed $50,000 annually, paid via Form MTA-6 quarterly estimates and reconciled on the NY personal return. Employers file quarterly through NYS-45 (which absorbed Form MTA-305). Exemptions cover federal government, certain NY state employees, agricultural employers, public school districts, and household employers."

name: or-cat
description: "Oregon Corporate Activity Tax is a gross receipts tax (not an income tax) imposed under ORS Chapter 317A on persons with Oregon commercial activity. The tax equals $250 plus 0.57% of taxable commercial activity above $1 million, after a subtraction of 35% of the greater of Oregon-apportioned cost of goods sold or Oregon-apportioned labor costs. Market-based sourcing applies. Registration is required at $750,000 of Oregon commercial activity. Quarterly estimated payments are due; annual return (Form OR-CAT) is due April 15. Grocery sales are excluded. Tax year 2025."

Out of scope: contribution rules for the self-employed and founders (serbia-social-contributions), the annual income tax (serbia-income-tax), non-residents and withholding on payments abroad (rs-cross-border)."

Covers the 22%, 9.5% and 5% rates and what falls in each, the EUR 60,000 small business exemption with its EUR 66,000 in-year ceiling, the EU SME cross-border exemption (EUR 100,000), monthly and quarterly periods (EUR 210,000 test), the DDV-O return by the last working day of the next month (the 20th for recapitulative statement filers, who still pay by the last working day), the VAT ledgers and prefilled return, domestic reverse charge, the RP-O recapitulative statement, VAT groups from 2026, fiscal cash registers, B2G e-invoices and B2B e-invoicing from 2028, fines and interest. Trigger phrases: DDV-O, Slovenian VAT, obračun DDV, evidenca obračunanega DDV, RP-O, PD-O, davčna blagajna. Out of scope: slovenia-income-tax, si-corporate-income-tax, slovenia-payroll, si-cross-border."

name: spain-crypto-tax
description: "Compute 2026 common-territory Spanish individual tax on cryptocurrency sales, swaps and qualifying investment staking. Covers global FIFO across exchanges, directly attributable fees, the greater-market-value swap rule, acquisition-lot continuity, separate savings baskets, limited loss offset and foreign third-party custody reporting on Modelo 721. Use for Bitcoin Spain, crypto tax Spain, criptomonedas IRPF, staking, exchange losses, foreign custody or digital-asset declaration questions. Distinguishes investment gains from employment, organised services, non-transfer gains and unpaid-credit losses. Includes two executable examples and the actual custody, threshold and cessation tests. Identifies unresolved reacquisition and specialist token cases rather than applying securities rules or retired penalties to every coin."

description: "ALWAYS read this skill before touching any Sri Lanka corporate income tax work. Use whenever asked about Sri Lanka company tax for a resident company. name: sweden-payroll

name: vi-bona-fide-residence
description: "US Virgin Islands bona fide residence and residence-change reporting reference checked in October 2026. Explains the separate presence, tax-home and closer-connection requirements, alternative presence tests for US citizens and resident aliens, and the distinction between residence and income sourcing. Covers arrival-year and departure-year exceptions and Form 8898 reporting triggers, individual income thresholds and separate filing. Uses current statutory text and IRS instructions, with examples that distinguish passing one test from proving residence. Excludes nonresident-alien and military special cases from the ordinary workflow. Independent accountant review and regulatory amendment reconciliation remain outstanding."

name: vi-gross-receipts-tax
description: "US Virgin Islands gross receipts tax reference using the August 2026 monthly return and the currently linked annual return. Covers the receipts base, five-percent rate, monthly exemption calculation, filing categories, deadlines, sole-proprietor consolidation, zero returns and documented government withholding. Includes examples showing why the monthly exemption is not an annual pooled deduction. Explicitly distinguishes the annual-filing boundary from the exemption wording at exactly 225,000 dollars. Uses official BIR forms while leaving the complete statutory amendment audit outstanding. Does not establish incentives, nexus, special-sector exemptions or the right to charge customers a separate tax. Independent accountant review remains pending."
